lines.text: Many learners say: Can you make a photo of us?
Better: Can you take a photo of us?
Take! Please take a photo of us.

data.wrong: Can you make a photo of us?
data.right: Can you take a photo of us?

native.tip: Im Deutschen „machen“ Sie ein Foto, im Englischen „take“: „take a photo“.

en.hook: How do you say “take a photo”?
en.tip: “Ein Foto machen” becomes “take a photo” in English, not “make”.
en.caption: How do you say “ein Foto machen” correctly? Wrong: “Can you make a photo of us?” Right: “Can you take a photo of us?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
